test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The milestone of having how many open defecation-free (ODF) Plus villages has been crossed by India in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**50,000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• India has reached the landmark of **50,000 ODF Plus **(open defecation-free) communities.
 
• **Telangana**, with **13,960** **ODF Plus **villages, is one of the best-performing States, followed by **Tamil Nadu** and **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• To ensure that all villages in the nation may proclaim themselves **ODF **Plus by the end of **2024**, **Swachh Bharat Mission Grameen Phase-II **was introduced in **February 2020.**
 
• The **Gobardhan Scheme**, the management of **biodegradable waste**, the management of **grey water,** the management of** plastic waste,** and the management of **feces sludge **were all parts of the aim to become **ODF Plus.**
 
• To **highlight **their development, the** ODF Plus communities **were split into three categories:** Aspiring, Rising, and Model. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• 
 ​The **Swachh Bharat Mission** was established by the** Indian Prime Minister** on **October 2, 2014**, in order to speed up efforts to attain universal sanitation coverage and to place sanitation front and center.
 
 
• 
 By building nearly 100 million toilets in rural India, the project aimed to have all villages, Gram Panchayats, Districts, States, and Union Territories declare themselves** "open-defecation free" (ODF) **by** 2 October 2019,** the 150th anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi's birth.
 
 
• 
 The Mission is advanced towards the next **Phase II of SBMG**, i.e. **ODF-Plus,** to ensure that open defecation-free behaviors are maintained, no one is left behind, and that solid and liquid waste management facilities are accessible.
 
 
• 
 Activities for ODF Plus under Phase II of the **Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen)** emphasized interventions for the secure management of solid and liquid waste in communities while reinforcing ODF behaviors.
